dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should grill a few more cookies for the children? Or perhaps that Bulle Fruit cake from the last time — that was pretty good.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Hehe, as long as the children like it, all is well.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: The adults here are very busy with work, so children often come and buy things for their families, and I bring them snacks when they do.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Sometimes that girl Navia drops by too, bringing gifts of all sizes. She asks for cake pretty often, too — just like a kid, she is...

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Take care, and mind you don't fall down!

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: I'm an old acquaintance of her father. Got a hand in her marksmanship, too, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: Of course, she didn't learn it here. This place is too small — any drawing of weapons isn't going to end well for anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Bracari
dialogues.text: If someone does dare cause trouble here, they will be sent away to start a new life in the ocean.
